say:1:1121103001:1.source_cn: 梅林大人，满满、漫漫！你们回来了！

say:2:1121103002:1.text: Whoa, it's so hot here! Was the Mystical House always this stuffy?
say:2:1121103002:1.source_cn: 呜哇，好热啊！神秘屋之前有这么闷热吗？

say:3:1121103003:1.text: I think my fur's going to dry out... Dolly, the temperature in here isn't quite right.
say:3:1121103003:1.source_cn: 漫漫的毛都好像要枯掉了……\n多莉小姐，神秘屋里的气温...

say:4:1121103004:3.text: I'm really sorry about this. It's one of the reasons why I wrote to you all...
say:4:1121103004:3.source_cn: 唉，非常抱歉，这就是我写信请求你们回来的原因之一了……

say:5:1121103005:1.text: While you were away, a <style="highlight">lovely lady</style> came by several times. The temperature rose after each of her visits.

say:6:1121103006:1.text: I had Miss Cassadee help me cool things down with her magic, but it didn't do much...
say:6:1121103006:1.source_cn: 我也试过请科丝蒂小姐用魔法造冰降温，不过效果有限……

choice_prompt:7:1121103006.text: I had Miss Cassadee help me cool things down with her magic, but it didn't do much...
choice_prompt:7:1121103006.source_cn: 我也试过请科丝蒂小姐用魔法造冰降温，不过效果有限……

say:8:1121103007:1.text: The lady didn't reveal her name, but she did mention that she was here to visit <style="highlight">someone very important</style>.
say:8:1121103007:1.source_cn: 那位女士没有留下自己的名字。不过，她曾说过，她来神秘屋...

say:9:1121103008:1.text: She also said she sensed a <style="highlight">familiar presence</style> in the area, but when questioned further, she seemed confused, as if she wasn't sure who she was looking for.
say:9:1121103008:1.source_cn: 她说在这附近感觉到了<style=highlight>...

say:10:1121103009:1.text: A mysterious person related to magic... Could she be here to see you, Magister Merlin?
say:10:1121103009:1.source_cn: 又神秘，又重要，还与魔法有关。我想，她是不是来找梅林大...
say:10:1121103009:1.male: A mysterious person related to magic... Could she be here to see you, Magister Merlin?
say:10:1121103009:1.female: A mysterious person related to magic... Could she be here to see you, Magister Merlin?

choice_prompt:11:1121103009.text: A mysterious person related to magic... Could she be here to see you, Magister Merlin?
choice_prompt:11:1121103009.source_cn: 又神秘，又重要，还与魔法有关。我想，她是不是来找梅林大人你的呢？
choice_prompt:11:1121103009.male: A mysterious person related to magic... Could she be here to see you, Magister Merlin?
choice_prompt:11:1121103009.female: A mysterious person related to magic... Could she be here to see you, Magister Merlin?

say:12:1121103010:1.text: The Mystical House is protected by your magic, and you're usually here most of the time... Maybe she detected you and your magic around here.
say:12:1121103010:1.source_cn: 神秘屋有你的魔法保护，而且我们也经常出入……可能那位女...
say:12:1121103010:1.male: The Mystical House is protected by your magic, and you're usually here most of the time... Maybe she detected you and your magic around here.
say:12:1121103010:1.female: The Mystical House is protected by your magic, and you're usually here most of the time... Maybe she detected you and your magic around here.

say:13:1121103011:1.text: Did she leave anything behind? A message, an insignia, or anything that identified her?
say:13:1121103011:1.source_cn: 她有留下什么东西吗？口信、纹章，或是其他能表明身份的东西？

say:14:1121103012:1.text: Only this. I found it next to the table after she left.
say:14:1121103012:1.source_cn: 只有这个。是那位女士离去后，我在桌旁捡到的。

say:16:1121103013:1.text: What a beautiful feather! It looks like it's on fire!
say:16:1121103013:1.source_cn: 好漂亮的羽毛！像是在熊熊燃烧一样！

say:17:1121103014:1.text: I can feel the magic emanating from it... and it's strong!
say:17:1121103014:1.source_cn: 确实能感觉到魔法的气息呢……而且很强！

say:19:1121103015:3.text: Magister Merlin, could you go talk to this lady? She seemed lost and confused. Chippy and Hammie, why don't you help the magister find her?
say:19:1121103015:3.source_cn: 梅林大人，满满和漫漫，能不能麻烦你们去找到那位女士呢？...
say:19:1121103015:3.male: Magister Merlin, could you go talk to this lady? She seemed lost and confused. Chippy and Hammie, why don't you help the magister find her?
say:19:1121103015:3.female: Magister Merlin, could you go talk to this lady? She seemed lost and confused. Chippy and Hammie, why don't you help the magister find her?

choice_prompt:20:1121103015.text: Magister Merlin, could you go talk to this lady? She seemed lost and confused. Chippy and Hammie, why don't you help the magister find her?
choice_prompt:20:1121103015.source_cn: 梅林大人，满满和漫漫，能不能麻烦你们去找到那位女士呢？看她迷茫又怅然的样子，我实在放心不下。
choice_prompt:20:1121103015.male: Magister Merlin, could you go talk to this lady? She seemed lost and confused. Chippy and Hammie, why don't you help the magister find her?
choice_prompt:20:1121103015.female: Magister Merlin, could you go talk to this lady? She seemed lost and confused. Chippy and Hammie, why don't you help the magister find her?

say:21:1121103016:1.text: If she found her way to the Mystical House by sensing your magic, we might run into her at places where you've <style="highlight">cast powerful spells</style> before.
say:21:1121103016:1.source_cn: 如果她是靠感应魔力才找到神秘屋来……那么，只要去梅林曾...
say:21:1121103016:1.male: If she found her way to the Mystical House by sensing your magic, we might run into her at places where you've <style="highlight">cast powerful spells</style> before.
say:21:1121103016:1.female: If she found her way to the Mystical House by sensing your magic, we might run into her at places where you've <style="highlight">cast powerful spells</style> before.

say:22:1121103017:1.text: For example, the northern highlands where the magister previously cast his ward!
say:22:1121103017:1.source_cn: 比如，之前梅林施加加护魔法的北方高地！
say:22:1121103017:1.male: For example, the northern highlands where the magister previously cast his ward!
say:22:1121103017:1.female: For example, the northern highlands where the magister previously cast her ward!

say:23:1121103018:1.text: Don't worry, Dolly. Just leave it to us!
say:23:1121103018:1.source_cn: 放心吧，多莉小姐，就包在我们身上！

choice:20:2:3.text: I can't say no to you.
choice:20:2:3.source_cn: 我不会拒绝女士的请求！
choice:20:2:3.male: I can't say no to you.
choice:20:2:3.female: I can't say no to you.

choice:11:0:1.text: Why does she want to see me?
choice:11:0:1.source_cn: 她为什么会来神秘屋找我？
choice:11:0:1.male: Why does she want to see me?
choice:11:0:1.female: Why does she want to see me?
